purpose: Freeze, solve, audit, and package a minimal Advantage2 reverse-annealing proof of concept from the passing Stage77 local swap-BQM gate, stopping before any external Leap query or paid QPU sampling.

instance_freeze.reward_quantile_independence_rule: Use q=0.5 only. Fixed-k reward quantiles are repeated encodings, not independent physical instances.
instance_freeze.positive_rule: Freeze every unique canonical fixed-k Stage77 instance whose best strict single-move improvement remains resolvable at four Q10 LSBs.
instance_freeze.calibration_assignment: Use only the sub-resolution PPARG diagnostic for hardware parameter calibration; keep both hardware-resolvable PPARG positives untouched until confirmation.
instance_freeze.negative_rule: For each target choose a canonical nonimproving instance by maximum logical-variable count, then largest k, then lowest outer-fold and source index. These are difficult size-matched controls, not easy empty models.
instance_freeze.subresolution_rule: Freeze the one canonical strict-improvement instance that failed the Stage77 Q10 resolution gate as the hardware-only calibration panel; it is excluded from confirmation endpoints.

exact_reference.formulation: Linearize every nonzero BQM product with binary McCormick constraints and enforce all remove/add conflicts explicitly.

classical_controls.purpose: Establish local solution-quality controls and exact targets before hardware. Runtime is not used for a speedup claim.

actual_embedding_gate.failure_action: Stop before QPU sampling and return the working-graph diagnostics.

preflight.operation: Query the live solver properties and working graph, verify reverse-anneal parameters, and freeze K38/K40 clique embeddings.

calibration.selection_order: Highest intact-chain fraction, lowest guarded logical energy, greatest cross-gauge stability, lowest chain prefactor, shallowest reverse depth, shortest pause. Confirmation-positive outcomes remain unread.

confirmation.primary_confirmation_set: Both independent PPARG confirmation-positive instances plus one hard negative from each of BACE1, PPARA, and PPARD.
confirmation.primary_endpoint: Each positive must recover a certified improvement in at least 13 of 16 embedding-by-gauge blocks and exceed forward annealing by at least five percentage points; negative controls must produce zero guarded strict improvements.

hardware_protocol.paid_safety_interlock: Calibration and confirmation each require both --authorize-paid-qpu and STAGE78_QPU_ACK=I_ACCEPT_STAGE78_QPU_CHARGES.
hardware_protocol.claim_boundary: This is a physical-hardware feasibility PoC with forward-QPU and classical controls. It is not a quantum advantage, scaling, biological-generalization, or end-to-end speedup experiment.

interpretation_boundary: Stage78 freezes historical-development BQMs, exact MILP references, classical solution-quality controls, and an external execution protocol. It performs no live solver query, no QPU sampling, no docking, and no fresh-validation or locked-test read. Passing Stage78 authorizes only an external Leap preflight; paid sampling remains explicitly user-authorized.
